name: Instinct Program
source:
Meet Adeline Shimizu, the main character of "Instinct Program", a principled and strong female  detective, who is investigating the disappearance of her colleague Christine Shore.​

[Edited from F95Zone]

---

"Instinct Program" is a Ren'Py remake of the [url=https://alakogames.blogspot.com/p/instinct-program.html]abandoned RAGS game[/url] of the same name.
